SELECT t1.table_name AS table_name, obj_description(('"' || t1.table_schema || '"."' || t1.table_name || '"')::regclass) AS table_comment, NULL AS table_collation, 'PostgreSQL' AS engine, NULL AS create_time, CASE WHEN t2.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isConfigured FROM information_schema.tables t1 LEFT JOIN gen_table t2 ON t1.table_name = t2.table_name WHERE t1.table_schema = current_schema() AND t1.table_type = 'BASE TABLE'
AND t1.table_name ILIKE CONCAT('%',#{queryParams.keywords},'%')
AND t1.table_name NOT IN
#{excludeTable}
ORDER BY t1.table_name ASC

SELECT t1.table_name AS table_name, obj_description(('"' || t1.table_schema || '"."' || t1.table_name || '"')::regclass) AS table_comment, NULL AS table_collation, 'PostgreSQL' AS engine, NULL AS create_time FROM information_schema.tables t1 WHERE t1.table_schema = current_schema() AND t1.table_name = #{tableName}

SELECT a.attname AS column_name, CASE t.typname WHEN 'int2' THEN 'smallint' WHEN 'int4' THEN 'integer' WHEN 'int8' THEN 'bigint' WHEN 'varchar' THEN 'varchar' WHEN 'bpchar' THEN 'char' WHEN 'timestamp' THEN 'timestamp' WHEN 'timestamptz' THEN 'timestamp' WHEN 'date' THEN 'date' WHEN 'time' THEN 'time' WHEN 'timetz' THEN 'time' WHEN 'bool' THEN 'boolean' WHEN 'numeric' THEN 'decimal' WHEN 'json' THEN 'json' WHEN 'jsonb' THEN 'json' WHEN 'text' THEN 'text' WHEN 'float4' THEN 'float' WHEN 'float8' THEN 'double' ELSE t.typname END AS data_type, col_description(a.attrelid, a.attnum) AS column_comment, CASE WHEN pk.conname IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isPrimaryKey, CASE WHEN a.attnotnull = false THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS isNullable, CASE WHEN t.typname IN ('varchar','bpchar') THEN a.atttypmod - 4 ELSE NULL END AS characterMaximumLength, NULL AS character_set_name, NULL AS collation_name FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON a.attrelid = c.oid JOIN pg_namespace n ON c.relnamespace = n.oid JOIN pg_type t ON a.atttypid = t.oid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cc.conname, cc.conrelid, UNNEST(cc.conkey) AS attnum FROM pg_constraint cc WHERE cc.contype = 'p' ) pk ON pk.conrelid = c.oid AND pk.attnum = a.attnum WHERE c.relname = #{tableName} AND n.nspname = current_schema() AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped ORDER BY a.attnum ASC
